dna.overview: Paranoid is two organisms. The intro hook works inside one E5 shape at the 12th fret: three hits with a 12–14 hammer-on, then a short run across the A and D strings. The verse riff is an engine: palm-muted, down-picked E5 eighths, a whole step down to D5, and a quick G5 – D5 – E5 turn back home. Later passes hold the E5 and slide down into G5 instead.
dna.rule: Muted E5 eighths + drop to D5 + G5–D5 turn home
dna.law: The eighths never stop and never change length, so the only movement you hear is harmonic: home, a step down, a short turn up and back. Because the pulse is fixed, the turn feels like an engine changing gear, not a new idea.
dna.failure: Alternate-pick or open up the palm mute and the riff loses its weight; skip the G5 before the D5 and the turn no longer pulls home.

mutation.title: Build a Paranoid relative — without copying the riff
mutation.description: Keep the engine, not the notes: one home power chord in steady eighths, a step down, and a short turn home.
steps: Pick a home power chord and play 16 palm-muted, down-picked eighths on it.
Drop a whole step for one bar with the same eighths.
Write a two-chord turn — a fourth above, then the step down — and land home on beat 3.
On the last pass hold the home chord for a bar and slide down into the turn instead.

atoms.label: E5: 12th fret low E + 14th fret A
atoms.tip: One shape carries the whole riff: index on the 12th fret, ring finger on the 14th.

atoms.label: 12–14 on the A string
atoms.tip: Pick the E5, then hammer the ring finger onto the 14th fret without picking again.

atoms.label: 12h14 on A, then D, then A
atoms.tip: Each pair is one pick stroke: pick the 12th, hammer the 14th, move one string.

atoms.label: (14) on the A string
atoms.tip: The last note is barely there: a soft touch that leads into the next pass.

atoms.label: E5 eighths under P.M.
atoms.tip: Rest the side of the picking hand on the strings at the bridge and play every eighth with a down stroke, all the same length.

atoms.label: D5: 10th fret low E + 12th fret A
atoms.tip: Slide the same shape two frets down, keep the palm mute.

atoms.label: Slide into G5 (10–12–12)
atoms.tip: Hit the G5 slightly from below and slide into the 10th fret.

atoms.label: Muted D string in the D5 shape
atoms.tip: The x is the D string touched by the finger: it adds a click, not a note.

atoms.label: 12th fret on D, G and B
atoms.tip: One finger flat across the 12th fret: a short top-string answer to the E5.

atoms.label: E5 held over the bar line
atoms.tip: Let the E5 ring two bars instead of chugging.

atoms.label: From E5 down into G5
atoms.tip: Slide the whole shape down from the 14th to the 10th fret, no new pick stroke.

atoms.label: E5 held for a bar
atoms.tip: The riff hangs on its home chord before the last turn.

atoms.label: From E5 down into G5
atoms.tip: Same slide as before: the shape travels down, the sound never stops.

atoms.label: Back to the muted E5 eighths
atoms.tip: Drop the palm back on the strings right after the D5.
